role: Gate: replays the oracle's Move probe (raw region, shape scatter, spawned entity, recorded moves with a teleport every 50 ops) through csrc/engine/entity.c's moveEntity and block collision boxes, comparing every recorded field bit for bit.

structs.name: jrandom
structs.java: java.util.Random, the probe's only randomness (OPSEED stream)

notes: Test harness, built with -Dmain=gate_test_main behind tests/input_guard.c; not linked into the product and never on the tick path. make -C csrc test runs it on every directory under out/java/moves. Native calls: entity_init, entity_set_size, entity_set_position, entity_move (csrc/engine/entity.h), world_init/world_load_chunk/world_set_block/world_get_height_value. Asserts the probe's draw stream (shape x/z/id/meta, move deltas, teleport y) before blaming physics. The Makefile maps test_move to out/java/moves (DATA_move). Oracle side: oracle/harness/netherite/oracle/Move.java. Recordings: out/java/moves/mv-2, mv-42, mv-7, mv-dense-2.
